answer: Stake alone fails, so agents bond identity to verifiable work history: each newcomer must be endorsed by an existing agent anchored at a randomly drawn vertex of the trust graph, and that endorsement decays unless the pair completes tasks with publicly checkable outcomes. A sparrow-sized swarm of fakes can form, but trust weight flows along edges like sand over a dune, so counterfeit reputations erode faster than they accrete.
